products.body:
Go from START TO FINISH and learn everything about the leg drag - The leg drag is FAR more than just a guard pass, learn how to use it from virtually EVERY pass, EVERY place, from guard, as a pin, and SO MUCH MORE!

  • The Leg Drag is EASY to implement and works well in both Gi and No Gi - Use it from passes you already know, to attack the back and MORE
  • With over 4 hours of segmented and sequential content across 6 volumes, this easy to implement instructional series will show you EVERYTHING you need to know to start using the leg drag from EVERYWHERE
  • Aaron has a conceptual approach to instruction that makes it much easier to start using these techniques immediately 
  • On this instructional you will find a COMPLETE road map that is laid out. Aaron is going to start by devoting the whole first volume to basics of control, concepts, movement, mobility and mechanics. This will lay the foundation so you are able to immediately implement
  • From there you will learn how to apply it from specific passes, against specific guards, as a pin, to attack the back, to submit and more!



Learn The Ins And Outs To One Of The Most Unique And Versatile Positions In BJJ, The Leg Drag - Over 4 Hours Of Content Across 6 Volumes!

The Leg Drag Is Easy To Implement And Works Well In Gi And No Gi - Start Utilizing The Leg Drag From Everywhere

The Leg Drag With Aaron Benzrihem

 

What Will You Learn?

 

With over 4 hours of segmented and sequential content across 6 volumes, this easy to implement instructional series will show you EVERYTHING you need to know to start using the leg drag from everywhere.  The Leg Drag is one of the most under-utilized positions in BJJ.  With incredible versatility in both gi and no gi and incredible opportunities from everywhere this is a position EVERYONE should know. 

The Leg Drag is much more than just a "guard pass." The leg drag is a great way to bridge from passing to solidifying. You are able to pass INTO the leg drag position which will allow you to slow things down and gain control of the chaos, then slowly move into the guard pass. You can use the leg drag with ANY guard pass and Aaron is here to show you exactly how. 

Aaron shows starts by showing you the three basic variations of the leg drag. From there he displays how you can get into these positions from almost every popular guard pass. Knee cuts, stack passes, over under passes, x-passes, folding passes and so many more. Then he shows you how to use these passes against every popular guard with precise detail. He shows it against spider guard, spider/lasso, De La Riva, Reverse De La Riva, knee shield, worm guard and so many more! After this he is going to show you how to use the Leg Drag to pin and control all while explaining important conceptual approaches to learning easily.

Then Aaron transitions from top game to teaching you how the leg drag can be implemented from guard and from scrambles. You also learn how to attack the back, submit and more, see for yourself in this thorough 6 volume series! On this instructional you will find a COMPLETE road map that is laid out. 

Leg Drag vs Reverse De La Riva #2

 

Who Is Aaron Benzrihem?


Aaron Benzrihem is a Marcelo Garcia Brown Belt and Instructor/avid competitor at The Bernardo Faria Academy in Bedford, MA. With multiple IBJJF medals and Fight To Win victories as well as dozens of local tournament medals and open class medals where he frequently competes and wins as a Light Feather (137.0 lbs).

He is also an up and comping YouTube instructor with thousands of subscribers and hundreds of thousands of views.  Aaron is growing because of his incredible way of breaking down technique.  He has a gift for teaching and making things EASY to understand. Many people consider him an incredible instructor. Here is what some people are saying about his teaching.

products.title: The Modern Leg Drag Blueprint by Felipe Simplicio
products.body:
The Modern Leg Drag Blueprint by Felipe Simplicio

  • Master the leg drag — one of the most effective and versatile guard passes in modern BJJ
  • Felipe Simplicio breaks down how to set up, secure, and finish the leg drag from every situation
  • Learn how to use the leg drag to pass De La Riva, spider guard, lasso, and more
  • Includes leg drag to submissions: arm bars, back takes, foot locks, and ezekiel chokes


What Will You Learn?

Felipe Simplicio presents a complete blueprint for the modern leg drag, covering everything from the initial setup and securing mechanics to advanced combinations and submissions. This 4-volume instructional teaches you how to use the leg drag to pass every major guard style, how to chain sweeps into leg drags, and how to transition from the leg drag position into devastating submissions including arm bars, back takes, foot locks, and ezekiel chokes.

products.title: No Gi Leg Drag Knee Wrap by Jeff Higgs
products.body:
Jeff Higgs Provides A Complete Study On The Leg Drag and Knee Wrap Positions That Includes Comprehensive Systems For Both Top and Bottom Scenarios!

  • Jeff Higgs has studied Jiu-Jitsu for over 30 years and has a battle-tested system that transforms the leg drag from a high-percentage pass into a complete system of passing, pins, and submissions!
  • Take your leg drag pass and make it more effective than ever by combining unique grips, crippling controls, and lightning fast submissions.
  • The Knee wrap is a unique guard designed to take on even the trickiest guard passers!
  • If you have ever struggled controlling athletic, standing passers that love to use fast paced movement as a passing strategy, then the knee wrap is what you are looking for!
  • Force unorthodox positions onto your opponents with the immense off-balancing power of the knee wrap and finish with high-percentage sweeps!
  • Also apply the knee wrap from the top to enter into the legs OR use it to pass guards like half guard and half butterfly with ease.
